The '''A43 Hushabye pistol''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] owned by [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tan Divo/Legends|Tan Divo]]. He wore the blaster on the left side of his police [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] with the handle facing forward.<ref name="TCWE" /> The criminal [[Lauli Wahlo/Legends|Lauli Wahlo]] also owned a A43 Hushabye pistol, although he added a [[Silencer (component)|silencer]].<ref name="LL Ep Guide old">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode211.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TanDivoblaster.png|left|thumb|200px|Tanivos Divo's A43 Hushabye pistol]]
The A43 Hushabye pistol first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Lightsaber Lost]]",<ref name="Lightsaber Lost">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref> which aired on [[January 22]], [[2010]].<ref name="LL Ep Guide old" /> It also briefly appeared in the episodes "[[Senate Murders]]" and "[[Sphere of Influence]]." It should be noted that chronologically "Sphere of Influence" occurs before "Senate Murders." It was first identified in Tan Divo's entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'', published on [[June 21]], 2010.
